title: Form Behavior
description: A plain <form> gets validation on submit, and with ajax it sends its fields to action with fetch instead of reloading the page, firing wb:form:submit, then wb:form:success or wb:form:error.

ajax.visualReason: Submits in the background instead of navigating. Only submitting shows it (#773).

validate.visualReason: Checks the fields when the form is submitted. Only submitting shows it (#773).

keepMessage.description: Keep the success message on screen instead of removing it after 5 seconds (errors still fade). For one-time actions such as joining a waitlist.
keepMessage.visualReason: Only shows after a successful ajax submit (#1961).

timeoutMs.description: How long an ajax submit may take, in milliseconds, before the error message shows and the form is usable again.
timeoutMs.visualReason: Only shows when a submit gets no answer in time (#1961).

wbBehavior.name: form
wbBehavior.description: Enhances forms with AJAX and validation support.

setup: <form id='test-form' action='/api/test' method='POST'><input name='a' value='1'><button type='submit'>Submit</button></form>
